summary: The single full occurrence is already quoted at 63/102 in Infectum I.1. No new example, sense, stem or idiom is supported.

rowe has the rider as sole subject in balki rowe, followed by howe šarxoš and a hoped-for fall. Wine prepared and administered in the preceding context supports becoming drunk, independently of the free German wording.
The event is possible and intended within the narrator's plan, not a reported completed intoxication. Infectum under balki does not establish a Preterit form or an additional result-state box.
The source is assigned to the intoxication homonym rwy 2; no evidence here justifies merging it with another rwy entry or expanding the meaning to other satiation domains.
The supplied German contains transcription irregularities, including Garte and erinnre. These do not alter the root's analysis and are not silently repaired in the inherited entry.
No Detransitive or light-verb construction is established by rowe with adjacent howe šarxoš; the latter is explanatory context.
